delights: It admits when it failed instead of hiding it: "Tried 5 recipe(s) for this slot, none fit within tolerance — closest was \"Grilled Portuguese sardines\" (delivered 56g protein vs a 79g target)." I would rather be told.
"Spanish Chicken" — Chicken Thighs 305g, Onion, Paprika, Lemon, Parsley, Chicken Stock, Olive Oil — 4g carb. That is the one dish that is actually keto AND something I would cook after a shift.
Regenerating was instant and did give me the full week I asked for: 28 slots across 7 days, where my saved plan only had one day in it.

defects.what: My hard no-pork line is broken six times across the week, including a whole pork-shoulder dinner. This is medical, not a preference.
defects.snippet: "Slow-roasted ham with lemon, garlic & sage" — Pork Shoulder 405g

defects.what: I am set to keto and I think low-carb, and no single day is remotely keto — the solver builds meals on quinoa, white rice, potato and beans.
defects.snippet: carbs per day: 106, 121, 115, 100, 105, 75, 147 g — day 6 includes Quinoa 170g, Russet Potato 45g, Pinto Beans 40g, Jersey Royal Potatoes 30g

defects.what: The app says my target is 1263 kcal and then hands me 2219-2523 kcal every day. Both numbers cannot be right and neither is explained.
I asked for 3 meals and 0 snacks. Every one of the 7 days has a snack slot bolted on, and the snacks are where most of the pork is.
defects.snippet: profile snacksPerDay: 0 — plan contains 7 slots with slotType "snack"

defects.what: My goal is maintain (67.4 kg to 67.3 kg, about a quarter pound) yet the account is set to a 1.5 lb/week loss rate. At 76, doing formwork concrete plus four 60-minute weight sessions, a 1263 kcal prescription is not something I would follow.
Ingredient scaling produces amounts that are not food. A quarter pound of rosemary as a side, and 13 grams of cabbage inside a cabbage stew.
defects.snippet: "Grilled Portuguese sardines" — Rosemary 105g; "Lakra me Mish Cabbage and Meat Stew" — Cabbage 13g, Beef 250g

followUp.action: Regenerated the whole week, hoping a fresh solve would drop the pork-rind snack and give me the seven days I originally asked for
followUp.howItWent: It worked mechanically and fast — I got 28 slots over 7 days instead of the single day that was saved. But it made the safety problem worse, not better: one pork slot became six pork hits, now including a 405 g pork-shoulder dinner and chorizo, and the snack slots I never asked for came back on all seven days.

verdict: It regenerates a full week in a second and it is honest about its own misses, but it fed me pork six times, ignored keto with 100-147 g of carbs a day, and prescribed 1263 kcal while serving 2400 — I would not put my name on it.
